query: What should I work on next?
expected_behavior: Lists open issues with gh issue list for the current milestone instead of reading a roadmap file in docs/
Picks the lowest open item by roadmap number, not by issue number

query: Start issue 9.1.2 and open a PR when it is done.
expected_behavior: Creates one branch for the one issue
Puts Closes #NNN for that issue in the PR body
Does not bundle a second issue into the same PR

query: Every issue in milestone M9 is merged. Wrap it up.
expected_behavior: Checks that the closing PR carries the acceptance record from docs/tools/sidebar-acceptance.md
Records the outcome in the milestone description or the closing PR, not in docs/

query: File an issue: the frustum cull test in Frustum.swift line 40 is slow, it iterates an Array.
expected_behavior: Writes the body as intent: the goal, the measured cost, and an acceptance gate in observable terms
Leaves the file path, line number, and pasted code out of the body
Runs the grep check from the skill on the body before gh issue create

query: Rename the local variable `idx` to `index` in BSAArchive.swift.
expected_behavior: Does not load starting-roadmap-work or query GitHub milestones

query: Start the next issue in M30. The lowest open item already has a draft PR.
expected_behavior: Checks gh pr list --state open before picking
Skips the item with the open PR and takes the next lowest roadmap number
